source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_EDS_DEP_ITCP WHERE H = 'D'

scripts.text:
TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_DEP_ITCP_SELECT_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_DEP_ITCP_SELECT_SRC
(
                BANK_ID,
                ENTITY_TYPE,
                ENTITY_ID,
                PREF_TYPE,
                PREF_SUB_TYPE,
                INT_PREF_SRL_NUM,
                START_DATE,
                END_DATE,
                PREF_RATE_CODE,
                PREF_RATE_PCNT,
                PREF_REMARKS,
                CONS_FOR_EFF_PREF,
                ENTITY_CRE_FLG,
                DEL_FLG,
                LCHG_USER_ID,
                LCHG_TIME,
                RCRE_USER_ID,
                RCRE_TIME,
                TS_CNT,
                FILE_NAME,
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)


SELECT 
                BANK_ID,
                ENTITY_TYPE,
                ENTITY_ID,
                PREF_TYPE,
                PREF_SUB_TYPE,
                INT_PREF_SRL_NUM,
                START_DATE,
                END_DATE,
                PREF_RATE_CODE,
                PREF_RATE_PCNT,
                PREF_REMARKS,
                CONS_FOR_EFF_PREF,
                ENTITY_CRE_FLG,
                DEL_FLG,
                LCHG_USER_ID,
                LCHG_TIME,
                RCRE_USER_ID,
                RCRE_TIME,
                TS_CNT,
                FILE_NAME,
				1 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_ITCP]
            WHERE H = 'D'
                AND CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8 )AS DATE) >= CAST(RCRE_TIME AS DATE);


INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_DEP_ITCP_SELECT_SRC
(
                BANK_ID,
                ENTITY_TYPE,
                ENTITY_ID,
                PREF_TYPE,
                PREF_SUB_TYPE,
                INT_PREF_SRL_NUM,
                START_DATE,
                END_DATE,
                PREF_RATE_CODE,
                PREF_RATE_PCNT,
                PREF_REMARKS,
                CONS_FOR_EFF_PREF,
                ENTITY_CRE_FLG,
                DEL_FLG,
                LCHG_USER_ID,
                LCHG_TIME,
                RCRE_USER_ID,
                RCRE_TIME,
                TS_CNT,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
                CC.BANK_ID,
                CC.ENTITY_TYPE,
                CC.ENTITY_ID,
                CC.PREF_TYPE,
                CC.PREF_SUB_TYPE,
                CC.INT_PREF_SRL_NUM,
                CC.START_DATE,
                CC.END_DATE,
                CC.PREF_RATE_CODE,
                CC.PREF_RATE_PCNT,
                CC.PREF_REMARKS,
                CC.CONS_FOR_EFF_PREF,
                CC.ENTITY_CRE_FLG,
                CC.DEL_FLG,
                CC.LCHG_USER_ID,
                CC.LCHG_TIME,
                CC.RCRE_USER_ID,
                CC.RCRE_TIME,
                CC.TS_CNT,
                CC.FILE_NAME,
		        0 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.DEP_ITCP CC
            JOIN [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_ITCP] B
            ON CC.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
            AND CC.ENTITY_TYPE = B.ENTITY_TYPE
            AND CC.ENTITY_ID = B.ENTITY_ID
            AND CC.PREF_TYPE = B.PREF_TYPE
            AND CC.PREF_SUB_TYPE = B.PREF_SUB_TYPE
            AND CC.INT_PREF_SRL_NUM = B.INT_PREF_SRL_NUM
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1' AND CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(B.FILE_NAME, 12), 8 )AS DATE) >= CAST(B.RCRE_TIME AS DATE);
	


TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_DEP_ITCP_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_DEP_ITCP_GROUP_SRC
(
                BANK_ID,
                ENTITY_TYPE,
                ENTITY_ID,
                PREF_TYPE,
                PREF_SUB_TYPE,
                INT_PREF_SRL_NUM,
                START_DATE,
                END_DATE,
                PREF_RATE_CODE,
                PREF_RATE_PCNT,
                PREF_REMARKS,
                CONS_FOR_EFF_PREF,
                ENTITY_CRE_FLG,
                DEL_FLG,
                LCHG_USER_ID,
                LCHG_TIME,
                RCRE_USER_ID,
                RCRE_TIME,
                TS_CNT,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT, 
				FILE_DATE
)

select 
                BANK_ID,
                ENTITY_TYPE,
                ENTITY_ID,
                PREF_TYPE,
                PREF_SUB_TYPE,
                INT_PREF_SRL_NUM,
                START_DATE,
                END_DATE,
                PREF_RATE_CODE,
                PREF_RATE_PCNT,
                PREF_REMARKS,
                CONS_FOR_EFF_PREF,
                ENTITY_CRE_FLG,
                DEL_FLG,
                LCHG_USER_ID,
                LCHG_TIME,
                RCRE_USER_ID,
                RCRE_TIME,
                TS_CNT,
				FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT,
				CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
                BANK_ID,
                ENTITY_TYPE,
                ENTITY_ID,
                PREF_TYPE,
                PREF_SUB_TYPE,
                INT_PREF_SRL_NUM,
                START_DATE,
                END_DATE,
                PREF_RATE_CODE,
                PREF_RATE_PCNT,
                PREF_REMARKS,
                CONS_FOR_EFF_PREF,
                ENTITY_CRE_FLG,
                DEL_FLG,
                LCHG_USER_ID,
                LCHG_TIME,
                RCRE_USER_ID,
                RCRE_TIME,
                TS_CNT,
				MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME, 
				SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_DEP_ITCP_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY 					
                BANK_ID,
                ENTITY_TYPE,
                ENTITY_ID,
                PREF_TYPE,
                PREF_SUB_TYPE,
                INT_PREF_SRL_NUM,
                START_DATE,
                END_DATE,
                PREF_RATE_CODE,
                PREF_RATE_PCNT,
                PREF_REMARKS,
                CONS_FOR_EFF_PREF,
                ENTITY_CRE_FLG,
                DEL_FLG,
                LCHG_USER_ID,
                LCHG_TIME,
                RCRE_USER_ID,
                RCRE_TIME,
                TS_CNT
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
WHERE FULLDATE = @DATETOPROCESS;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.DEP_ITCP A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_DEP_ITCP_GROUP_SRC B ON
COALESCE(A.BANK_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BANK_ID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.ENTITY_TYPE,'-1') = COALESCE(B.ENTITY_TYPE,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.ENTITY_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.ENTITY_ID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.PREF_TYPE,'-1') = COALESCE(B.PREF_TYPE,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.PREF_SUB_TYPE,'-1') = COALESCE(B.PREF_SUB_TYPE,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.INT_PREF_SRL_NUM,'-1') = COALESCE(B.INT_PREF_SRL_NUM,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1

(
                BANK_ID,
                ENTITY_TYPE,
                ENTITY_ID,
                PREF_TYPE,
                PREF_SUB_TYPE,
                INT_PREF_SRL_NUM,
                START_DATE,

                DEL_FLG,
                LCHG_USER_ID,
                LCHG_TIME,
                RCRE_USER_ID,
                RCRE_TIME,
                TS_CNT,
				SCD_START_DATE, 
				SCD_END_DATE, 
				ISACTIVE, 
				ISLATEST, 
				BNK_CODE, 
				SOURCE_CODE, 
				FILE_NAME, 
				insert_dttm
)
SELECT
                BANK_ID,
                ENTITY_TYPE,
                ENTITY_ID,
                PREF_TYPE,
                PREF_SUB_TYPE,
                INT_PREF_SRL_NUM,
                START_DATE,
                END_DATE,
                PREF_RATE_CODE,
                PREF_RATE_PCNT,
                PREF_REMARKS,
                CONS_FOR_EFF_PREF,
                ENTITY_CRE_FLG,
                DEL_FLG,
                LCHG_USER_ID,
                LCHG_TIME,
                RCRE_USER_ID,
                RCRE_TIME,
                TS_CNT,
				@DATETOPROCESS,
				'9999-12-31',
				1,
				1,
				SRC.BANK_ID,
				'DEP',
				SRC.FILE_NAME,
				CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime)
FROM d360.STG_EDS_DEP_ITCP_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT > 0
